earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 mmc3q2026ex991newsrelease.htm PRESS RELEASE SEPTEMBER 30, 2026 Document Marsh 212 345 5000 www.marsh.com News release Exhibit 99.1 Marsh reports third quarter 2026 results • Revenue Growth of 8%; Underlying Revenue Growth of 5% • GAAP Operating Income Increases 4%; Adjusted Operating Income Increases 6% • Third Quarter GAAP EPS of $1.69; Adjusted EPS Increases 10% to $2.03 • Nine Months GAAP EPS of $6.68; Adjusted EPS Increases 9% to $8.29 NEW YORK , October 15, 2026 – Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. John Doyle, President and CEO, said: "Marsh delivered a strong third quarter, generating 5% underlying revenue growth and double-digit EPS growth. We also made significant progress in executing our Thrive program and successfully completed our brand transition." "These results reflect the strength of our market position, the value we deliver to clients, and the commitment of our colleagues around the world." Consolidated Results Effective January 14, 2026, the Company updated its brand name from Marsh McLennan to Marsh and the brand names of Marsh and Oliver Wyman Group businesses to Marsh Risk ("Risk") and Marsh Management Consulting ("Management Consulting"), respectively. As a result of the Company's previously announced brand change, results that were previously reported under our Guy Carpenter business will now be reported as "Reinsurance" and results that were previously reported as Mercer will now be reported as "People and Investments". Within People and Investments, results for Wealth will now be reported as "Investments and Retirement", Health will now be reported as "Health and Benefits" and Career will now be reported as "Workforce and Rewards". Consolidated revenue in the third quarter of 2026 was $6.9 billion, an increase of 8% compared with the third quarter of 2025, or 5% on an underlying basis. Operating income increased 4% to $1.2 billion. Adjusted operating income, which excludes noteworthy items and identified intangible amortization expense as presented in the attached supplemental schedules, rose 6% to $1.5 billion. Net income attributable to the Company was $808 million. Earnings per share were $1.69. Adjusted earnings per share increased 10% to $2.03. 1 For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue was $21.9 billion, an increase of 7% on a GAAP basis or 5% on an underlying basis, compared to the prior year period. Operating income was $4.9 billion, a decrease of 3% from the prior year period. Adjusted operating income rose 7% to $6.1 billion. Net income attributable to the Company was $3.2 billion, or $6.68 per diluted share, compared with $6.75 in the first nine months of 2025. Adjusted earnings per share increased 9% to $8.29. Risk and Insurance Services Risk and Insurance Services revenue was $4.2 billion in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 7%, or 3% on an underlying basis. Operating income decreased 1% to $745 million, while adjusted operating income increased 4% to $1.0 billion. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, revenue was $14.1 billion, an increase of 6%, or 3% on an underlying basis. Operating income decreased 7% to $3.5 billion, and adjusted operating income increased 5% to $4.6 billion. Risk's revenue in the third quarter of 2026 was $3.7 billion, an increase of 10%, or 5% on an underlying basis. In U.S./Canada, underlying revenue growth was 4%. In International, underlying revenue growth was 6%, and included 7% growth in EMEA, 4% growth in Asia Pacific, and flat in Latin America. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, Risk’s underlying revenue growth was 4%. Reinsurance's revenue in the third quarter was $374 million, a decrease of 6%, on both a GAAP and underlying basis. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, Reinsurance's revenue decreased 1% on an underlying basis. Consulting Consulting revenue was $2.7 billion in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 9%, or 8% on an underlying basis. Operating income increased 12% to $563 million, while adjusted operating income increased 9% to $593 million. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, revenue was $7.8 billion, an increase of 10%, or 7% on an underlying basis. Operating income rose 13% to $1.6 billion, and adjusted operating income increased 11% to $1.7 billion. People and Investments' revenue in the third quarter was $1.7 billion, an increase of 6%, or 5% on an underlying basis. Investments and Retirement revenue grew 8%, Health and Benefits revenue increased 5%, and Workforce and Rewards revenue decreased 1%, all on an underlying basis. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, People and Investments’ revenue was $4.9 billion, an increase of 5% on an underlying basis. Management Consulting's revenue in the third quarter of 2026 was $1.0 billion, an increase of 14% on both a GAAP and underlying basis. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, Management Consulting’s revenue was $2.9 billion, an increase of 11% on an underlying basis. Other Items The Company repurchased approximately 2.7 million shares of stock for $500 million in the third quarter of 2026. Through nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company has repurchased 11.4 million shares of stock for $2.0 billion. In the third quarter of 2026, the Company repaid 550 million of Euro-denominated senior notes that matured in September. 2 Conference Call A conference call to discuss third quarter 2026 results will be held today at 8:30 a.m. Eastern time. The live audio webcast may be accessed at marsh.com. A replay of the webcast will be available approximately two hours after the event. The webcast is listen-only. Those interested in participating in the question-and-answer session may register here to receive the dial-in numbers and unique PIN to access the call. About Marsh Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 3 INFORMATION CONCERNING FORWARD-LOOKING STATEMENTS This press release contains "forward-looking statements," as defined in the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. reference.summary: Marsh & McLennan Companies, Inc., a professional services company, provides advisory services and insurance solutions to clients in the areas of risk, strategy, and people worldwide. The company operates through Risk and Insurance Services, and Consulting segments. The Risk and Insurance Services segment offers risk management services, such as risk management, insurance broking, insurance program management, risk consulting, analytical modeling, and alternative risk financing services. This segment also offers insurance and reinsurance broking, strategic advisory and actuarial services, and analytics solutions. It serves businesses, public entities, insurance companies, associations, professional services organizations, and private clients.
